chunks: And from him, from al-Nadr ibn Suwayd, from 'Asim ibn Humayd, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, who said:

I asked Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him): Did the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) pray Dhuhr in Mina on the Day of Tarwiyah? He said: 'Yes, and the morning prayer in Mina on the Day of Arafah.'
And when a person intends to head to Mina, let him supplicate with the supplication that was narrated:

key_terms.مِنًى: Mina, a location near Mecca used during Hajj
key_terms.يَوْمَ التَّرْوِيَةِ: The Day of Tarwiyah (8th of Dhu al-Hijjah)
key_terms.يَوْمَ عَرَفَةَ: The Day of Arafah (9th of Dhu al-Hijjah)

ai.seo_question: Did the Prophet pray in Mina on the days of Tarwiyah and Arafah?
ai.summary: This narration from Shaykh al-Tusi’s *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* establishes the Sunnah of the Prophet (peace be upon him) performing Dhuhr and Fajr prayers in Mina on the 8th and 9th of Dhul-Hijjah, respectively, thereby validating the practice of shortening (Qasr) prayers during Hajj. It serves as a foundational text for the jurisprudential ruling that pilgrims should offer two-rak'ah prayers in Mina rather than four, reflecting the Prophet's practical guidance during the Farewell Pilgrimage.
